market.question: WTI Crude Oil (WTI) Up or Down on April 27?

assessment.reasoning: WTI climbed nearly 2% on April 27 in early trading amid Strait of Hormuz tensions; today's range $95.45-$96.67 versus prior session implies gain. Price has been holding gains through the day with stalled US-Iran talks supporting bid. Up is the heavily favored outcome.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Late-session reversal risk on de-escalation headlines.
